_about: Define's feature list — step 6.66, founder ruling 2026-09-25 (ARCHITECTURE.md v1.78). Anthropic's long-running-harness pattern: ONE list; a feature passes only when its end-to-end test passes. There is NO status field — status is derived from docs/test-results.json by tools/control_board/features.py. Derived from four sources, cited per feature: ARCHITECTURE.md, the procedure (steps, Appendix G gaps, Appendix H capability rows), the code, and Anthropic/LangChain guidance. 'provenance' records the procedure steps, capability rows and gaps each feature was derived from (6.66), and as notes_6_66 the prose absence-claims the draft carried as code citations; code citations are path::symbol, checked by tools/control_board/citations.py. Lanes: A coaching, B gate, C screen and inputs, integrator end-to-end joins. Every feature cites ONE requirement id in 'requirement': a RATIFIED or ACCEPTED id of docs/requirements/business.md, or an ACCEPTED T id of docs/requirements/platform.md (never a PROPOSED, DRAFT or RETIRED one). The order of work is COMPUTED, never stored (ADR-0058, brief Part F3): tools/control_board/rank.py ranks every failing feature from its requirement's MoSCoW and the feature's belt_impact (dead_end | wrong_data | data_loss | degraded | none), rework_risk (high | low), effort (S | M | L), depends_on and priority_override (null, or {rank_tier, reason} — founder only). Edit a feature's description, test or sources in place; never add a status. phase (define | measure | …), stage (open_case | coached | report | approve | record_written | next_phase — where in the Belt's journey) and layer (screen | api | coaching | gate | persistence | platform) place each feature on the board's value stream (brief Part F7). PILOT (RETIRED, founder ruling 2026-10-20: Define is done when every Define feature passes, except Won't-now; Measure starts only then): the `pilot` field is kept on each feature and still type-checked (true | false, rank.py), but nothing reads it — the board's M2 is one milestone. PACKAGES (founder ruling 2026-10-20: work runs in fixed packages, one prompt = one package): every failing Define feature carries `package` (P1..P35) as the founder listed it; rank.py chooses the package that holds a lane's top-ranked failing feature (ADR-0058 note). MERGED (same ruling): a feature folded into another carries `merged_into` (its id), shares that feature's test, and is left out of the Define count and the rank. DEFINE COUNT (same ruling): only features with phase "define" and no `merged_into` are counted (features.counted). BUILD (founder ruling 2026-10-20): phase "build", stage "build", layer "tooling" mark the commit hook and tooling features (package P0); phase build keeps them out of the Define count.
